items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I was there the night that John Hammond and Benny Goodman called from Chicago... I was there that night.

ctx.x: Can you remember what year this was? Because ...

That's the Fall of '34 and the Spring of '35. I was there the night that John Hammond and Benny Goodman called from Chicago, and asked Basie if he wanted to leave and go to to the Grand Terrace -- I was there that night. I saw them flip; I was around there that Spring of '35, again, when they were building the band.
I was there the night that Lester (Young) joined the band -- he'd already added guitar, and he had added -- he added Lester, whom I didn't know but I met him; he added ...
